title: Maintenance Request
description: Invocation of one deterministic operation projected from src/standard/command-registry.ts. This is not a prompt: no model is invoked unless the registry declares the operation model-backed. Only registry entries are invocable; there is no free-form command surface and no argument may turn one entry into a different command.

project.description: Absolute project path, declared explicitly and resolved by exact match against the project registry.

operation.description: Registry command identifier, for example "wiki index". An identifier absent from the registry is refused; shell metacharacters cannot appear by construction of this pattern.

args.description: Validated against the registry entry's declared argument shape before anything runs. Unknown keys are refused rather than ignored.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeated key returns the original invocation and starts nothing.
